messages:
maria: Heads-up — I found a VPN rewrite that injects an email header into requests for /v1/relay. Some of those requests were sampled and ended up in analytics exports. possible PII leak.

jon: Can you paste a repro snippet or an anonymized example? :eyes:

maria: Repro: from corp VPN curl to internal proxy. Header present: `X-User-Ident: alice@example.com`. Saw logs like: `INFO relay req_id=abc123 route=/v1/relay headers={..., X-User-Ident: alice@example.com} sampled=true body_attached=true` (sanitized).

ashwin: That matches the telemetry spike. Current sampler respects route-rate + global policies but not a per-route body-export deny. We need a non-brittle approach — don’t just regex-scrub headers.

katie: Proposal: route metadata `sensitive: true|false`. If sensitive=true then sampler enforces `export_body=false` and `export_headers=allowlist`. Console exposes a strict mode toggle (opt-in) and breakglass flow for temporary debug.

jon: Do we ever need bodies for those routes in normal debugging? If not, breakglass ephemeral inspect to an audit-only store sounds right.

ashwin: Implementation sketch: 1) add route metadata and migration; 2) sampler consults route.sensitive and sets export flags; 3) console shows sensitivity badge + auditable override button.

maria: Also suggest heuristic detection: if a header value contains `@` in >0.1% of requests/day mark as candidate in UI (no auto-flip).

ashwin: Add metric `route_pii_indicator_rate` and an alert if >0.05% AND any sampled_with_body > 0.

jon: Draft route config (WIP):
```yaml
routes:
  - id: relay-v1
    path: /v1/relay
    sensitive: true  # runtime-only, default false
    sampling:
      policy: route-aware
```

katie: UX constraints: require two-step confirmation + compliance tag to flip sensitive->false. Dashboard card: "sampled_with_body" per route + scrubbed preview that redacts emails.

sre-bot: deploy: /services/relay updated (deploy id dpl-2026-02-12-03) — PR #3210 by @devops changed header propagation.

maria: PR #3210 likely added the X-User-Ident header for routing; it didn't consider analytics export.

ashwin: Action items: katie -> console mock + breakglass copy (ETA EOD), ashwin -> metric + alert (ETA tomorrow), jon -> sampler check + feature-flagged PR (end of week), maria -> export list of affected req_ids and log lines.

katie: I'll include the compliance copy for legal and a mock for the two-step flow. :thumbsup:

jon: I'll gate the sampler change behind a feature flag and add unit tests asserting export_body=false for sensitive routes.

maria: I'll purge known sampled records from analytics and open purge ticket for security/compliance. Also running a search to find other routes leaking emails in headers.

ashwin: For visibility add a console alert "PII candidate detected" linking to the route and showing `route_pii_indicator_rate`. Owners can remediate before leaks escalate.

maria: If you see other headers with email patterns drop them here. I'll post PR numbers and purge ticket when ready.

jon: Thanks folks — good catch and quick triage."
